description: This file defines classes and objects for simulating website page views and generating streaming clickstream events, including a PageView class, a generator object, and a main method to produce simulated data over a network socket.

classes.name: PageView
classes.description: Represents a website page view with URL, status code, zip code, and user ID.

methods.name: PageView.fromString
methods.description: Creates a PageView instance from a tab-separated string.

methods.name: pickFromDistribution
methods.description: Selects an item from a probability distribution map.

methods.name: getNextClickEvent
methods.description: Generates a new PageView event as a string based on random distributions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method to run the streaming page view generator, accepting port and views per second as arguments.
